Plot the parts of an EAP and MAP estimation

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_prior.Rd

Draw the parts of an estimation from eap_map():

plot_prior()

the prior weights at the quadrature points;

plot_tracelines()

the probability of each observed response across ability, blue for items answered correctly and red for items answered incorrectly;

plot_likelihood()

the likelihood, the product of those probabilities;

plot_posterior()

the posterior, with lines and values for the EAP (blue) and the MAP (red);

plot_eap_combined()

the prior (red), likelihood (blue) and posterior (black, rescaled to be comparable) in one plot, with dashed lines at the prior mean and the posterior mean.

Usage

plot_prior(estimate)

plot_tracelines(estimate)

plot_likelihood(estimate)

plot_posterior(estimate)

plot_eap_combined(estimate)

Arguments

estimate

Result of eap_map().

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

estimate <- eap_map(response_pattern(2))
plot_prior(estimate)


plot_tracelines(estimate)


plot_likelihood(estimate)


plot_posterior(estimate)


plot_eap_combined(estimate)
